Hola buenas tardes quiero agradecer al jefe  en Pto. Iguazú en la estación de servicio en ruta 12 German Salomonzon y Federico Federico Chilesqui  además todo el personal incluído jefe de Playa Carlina Villaverde y una vez más a todos por haberme permitido estar a un costado de la est. Hello, good afternoon. I want to thank the manager at the ACA YPF service station on Route 12 in Puerto Iguazú, Germán Salomonzón, and Federico Chilesqui, as well as all the staff, including the forecourt manager, Carlina Villaverde. Once again, thank you to everyone for allowing me to park next to the YPF station and for giving me electricity for a small cooler I carry in my truck. I am very grateful to the ACA and all its staff. The only thing missing is a shower for the general public. Thank you to everyone at the ACA YPF station on Route 12 in Puerto Iguazú.
